# Nicolae Cojuhari (nicojuhari.com)

> Senior full-stack engineer in Vienna, Austria. 10+ years building web applications (TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL), and 5 years in banking and credit before that. Open to full-time roles in Vienna (hybrid) or remote. Also takes on a few freelance projects for small businesses.

## About
- [About](https://nicojuhari.com/about): career path - credit economist (2009), first code for a credit company (2014), web agencies in the UK (2016-2019), senior software engineer at bwin in Vienna (2020-2024), own products since 2024.
- [CV (English)](https://nicojuhari.com/cv) · [Lebenslauf (Deutsch)](https://nicojuhari.com/de/cv)

## Case studies
- [EPUfix](https://nicojuhari.com/projects/epufix): invoicing and bookkeeping app for self-employed people in Austria. Next.js, Supabase (Postgres with row-level security and triggers), Stripe. Austrian invoice rules and a tax estimate in code.
- [Ideal Credit Management](https://nicojuhari.com/projects/ideal-credit-system): loan management system for a consumer credit company, used every day. Rebuilt from Express and MySQL to Next.js and Postgres. Daily interest and penalty engine, payment allocation, regulator reports.
- [Handwerker Netz](https://nicojuhari.com/projects/handwerker-netz): bilingual website for a Vienna handyman business he co-owns. Data-driven service pages, structured data, local SEO.
- [All work](https://nicojuhari.com/projects)

## Freelance services
